g.text: Hook: primary cap axial retention on hook side
M3×1: anti-reverse slide + opposite-side axial retention + lock indicator
Drive torque remains shaft → headed M4 → collar → yokes → hub → 12T
Hook / M3 / cap are NOT primary drivetrain torque members
